correctness.rationale: PASS: Every query leaves ℓ positive and n−ℓ negative starts, hence a depth-d tree needs 2^(d−1)≤w=min(ℓ,n−ℓ). Root query at x=ℓ−1 leaves consecutive blocks of 2^floor(log₂w) starts on either branch. Every block of size ≤w can be split exactly at a chosen prefix by querying its cut position; balanced recursive cuts attain 1+floor(log₂w). Cyclic-gap traces yield 1+n z+n(w−1)z² (no triple can be shattered). Łoś transfers fixed finite-depth witnesses and finite 2-rank characterizes stability of this formula. Independent exact rank/minimax checks for all 136 (n,ℓ) pairs n=2..17 matched. Not a classification of the entire ultraproduct theory.
